reportIssue.message: Report a bug / request a feature

openHaiiloToViewDetails.message: Open a Haiilo page to view hidden content details.

nothingHidden.message: Nothing is hidden on this page right now.

couldNotLoadHiddenDetails.message: Could not load hidden content details.

extensionStatusDescription.message: Temporarily turn off all extension features (muting, avatar styling, messenger expansion, date overrides) without uninstalling the extension.

mutingDescription.message: Right-click any username on Haiilo and choose Haiilo Enhancer → Mute for …. Muted users' posts and comments are hidden on every page until they expire. Unmute them from this extension's toolbar popup, via the context menu, or by adding them again with "Permanently" off and waiting it out.

defaultMutePeriod.message: Default mute period (used by "Mute for default period"):

showHiddenCount.message: Show badge with hidden content count on the extension icon

dateTimeDescription.message: Override Haiilo's default date and time display. New installs can match the browser locale automatically; existing installs can re-apply the locale preset with the button below.

chooseLocalePreset.message: Choose a locale-based preset. Changing this will also reset time format to that preset's default.

replaceGroupIcons.message: Replace generic group chat icons with individual channel initials

avatarDescription.message: Customize how group chat avatars appear to distinguish them from individual users.

distinguishGroupChats.message: Choose how to visually distinguish group chats from individual users

customizeRing.message: Customize the ring border color and width

customizeSquare.message: Customize the square border color and width

adjustBadgeSize.message: Adjust the size of the badge icon overlay (percentage of base size)

chooseBadgePosition.message: Choose where the badge icon appears on the avatar

customHomepageDescription.message: Set which homepage the logo redirects to for each Haiilo instance. Right-click on a homepage tab (e.g., "Home", "Home (soft)") and select "Set as default homepage" to configure.

reactionsDescription.message: Improve how emoji reactions are displayed on posts and comments.

sortReactions.message: Sort reaction emojis by count (most used first)

reactionTooltip.message: Show reaction count breakdown on hover (e.g. 👍22 💡2)

reactionInline.message: Show reaction counts inline next to the emojis

autoExpandDescription.message: Haiilo's left sidebar shows a limited number of Workspaces and Pages before hiding the rest behind a "Show more" button. Enable this to auto-click that button on page load so all entries are visible at once.

autoExpand.message: Auto-expand sidebar lists on page load

chooseLists.message: Choose which sidebar lists the auto-expander should affect.

clicksHelp.message: How many times to click "Show more" for each list (Workspaces and Pages are expanded independently). 0 disables clicking for that list. Max 10.

delayHelp.message: How long to wait between consecutive "Show more" clicks. Lower values feel snappier, higher values are gentler on the server. Range: 100-1000 ms.

customDomainsDescription.message: If your organization uses a custom Haiilo URL (not *.haiilo.app or *.haiilo.com), add it here. The browser will ask you to grant access the first time — that's expected, it just means "yes, run on this site too."

domainHelp.message: Enter just the domain name (e.g., intranet.company.com)

chromePermissionWarning.message: Note: Due to a Chrome limitation, domain permissions cannot be revoked after being granted. Removing a domain here stops the extension from using it, but the permission will remain visible in chrome://extensions until you reinstall the extension.

syncSettings.message: Sync settings and muted users via browser account

syncHelp.message: When enabled, your settings and up to 50 muted users are stored in your browser's built-in sync storage and roam across devices. Custom domains are excluded — re-add them manually on each device. Cloud sync is disabled automatically if your muted list exceeds 50 users.

cloudSyncDisabledDescription.message: Your muted users list exceeded the 50-user limit for cloud sync. Your data is still stored locally and nothing was lost. To re-enable cloud sync, reduce your muted users list to 50 or fewer.

backupDescription.message: Export your settings and muted users to a JSON file as a backup, or import a previous export to restore them. Reset to Defaults wipes everything; export first if you might want to undo it.

domainsNeedPermissionDescription.message: The following domains were in your backup but could not be restored automatically — browser security requires you to grant access manually:

domainsNeedPermissionHowTo.message: To re-add them: scroll down to Custom Haiilo Domains, enter each domain, and click Add Domain to grant browser access.

footerTagline.message: The Haiilo experience, enhanced for you

noCustomDomains.message: No custom domains added. Default: *.haiilo.app and *.haiilo.com

noCustomHomepages.message: No custom homepages set. Use the context menu on a homepage tab to set one.

validDomain.message: Please enter a valid domain name

permissionDenied.message: Permission denied. You must grant access to this domain.

invalidImport.message: Invalid file format - must contain mutedUsers and/or settings

cloudSyncUnavailable.message: Cloud sync is not available. Make sure you are signed into your browser account.

resetComplete.message: All settings have been reset to defaults

icsDownloaded.message: ICS file downloaded. Open it from your browser downloads to import it.

importDomainsNeedReauth.message: $COUNT$ custom domain(s) need manual re-authorization (see warning above)

confirmReset.message: Are you sure you want to reset everything to defaults? This cannot be undone.

themeHelp.message: Default follows your browser's light/dark setting.
